item.tib: pha rgyud rig pa khu byug gsang mchog mthar thug rgyud las me dpung 'khor lo bzlog pa'i 'phyong
item.coloph: dpal gsang mchog bsnyen sgrub kyi gzhung las/ las kyi mtha' bsgyur me dpung 'khor lo zlog pa'i 'phyong / dbal stag la me 'bar gyis gtan la phab pa'o// u tra sig/ sprul pa'i sku mchog blo ldan snying po'i snyan du brgyud pa dge legs 'phel/ u ya smar ro//
